fix_command:
for f in /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.sources; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || continue
  cp -n "$f" "$f.sf3000.bak"
  sed -i -E -e 's|https?://[a-z0-9.-]*archive\.ubuntu\.com/ubuntu|http://old-releases.ubuntu.com/ubuntu|g' -e 's|https?://security\.ubuntu\.com/ubuntu|http://old-releases.ubuntu.com/ubuntu|g' "$f"
done
